question: Which of the following laws represented by the formula T2/R3, compares the orbital period and radius of the orbit of a planet with that of other planets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kepler's Third Law.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kepler's Third Law:-**

 
 
• **It is also known as the Law of Harmonies, which states that the square of the orbital period of a planet is directly proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis of its orbit.**
 
• This law compares the orbital periods and radii of planets with each other and with the Sun.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hubble's Law:-**

 
 
• It is used to determine the rate of expansion of the universe.
 
 
 
• **Copernicus's Law:-**
 
 
• It Law states that the planets revolve around the Sun, and not the Earth.
 
 
 
• **Bragg's Law:-**
 
 
• It is used to determine the angles at which X-rays diffract from a crystal lattice.
